items.title: Qatl hogaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
items.body:
Qatl hogaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Hai lahu bhara Chehra, kaisi runumaai hai
Dekhne ko ye manzar, ab Dulhan bhi Aayi hai
Ek din ki thi Shaadi, hashr tak judaai hai
Karbala ke Dulha ki, Laash ghar me Aayi hai

<<MINI>>

Qatl hogaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Do jaha’n na kyun rowe, ye Ali ka Pota hai
Bekasi pa Qasim ki, dil shikista hota hai
Ye zameen Roti hai, aasma’n bhi rota hai
Ab kisi ko sakta hai, koi jaan khota hai

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Kis liye tadapte hain, kisko jaa'ein samjhaane
Kya guzarti hai Ham par, Wo to bas Khuda Jaane
Qalb bhi Hamare hain, Shaah ke Aza khaane
Hain Aza e Qasim me, aasuon ke nazraane

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Aaj Karbala waale, phir hamare mehma hain
Phool ho ke mehndi ho, sab Aza ke saama’n hain
Ehtemaam shaadi ke, ik Bahan ke armaa’n hain
Ghamzado’n ke nazraane, aansuon ke toofaa’n hain

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Ye Sadaa-e Maatam hai, ik payaame bedaari
Is liye rago’n me hai, khoon e zindagi jaari
Zindagi Hamari hai, Shaah ki Azadaari
Khud shareeke Majlis hai, ek Ghareeb Dukhiyaari

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Ran se Laasha e Naoshah, laay jis ghadi Sarwar
Zindagi ka har lamha, phir to ban gaya nashtar
Har qadam qayamat thi, har qadam pa tha mehshar
Reh gaya nigaho’n me, ye lahu bhara manzar

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Bain the ye Kubra ke, ab to ghut raha hai dam
Bolte nahi’n kuch bhi, aaj Mere Ibne amm
Kis tarah se dikhlaaein, apne dil ka ye aalam
Boliye Phupi Amma, chup rahein ke roe’n ham

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Misle Fatima Kubra, kaunsi Dulhan hogi
Sar to berida hoga, haath me rasan hogi
Laash jiske waaris ki, ran me bekafan hogi
Aye Rafi is Gham me, qaom seenazan hogi

<<MINI>>

Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai

items.title: Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezabaa'n Asghar
items.body:
Bekasi me kya Meri aas toot jaaegi
Ab Tumhare jhoole me kisko Maa jhulaaegi
Dasht ke andhere me kaise neend aaegi
Ghut rahi hain seene me kab se loriya’n Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

<<DIVIDER>>

Dekhne ko zinda thi Maa wo karb ka manzar
Kya sitam hua Beta aah Teri gardan par
Teere zulm kya kam tha haay phir chala khanjar
Gir pada na dharti par kyun ye asmaa’n Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

<<DIVIDER>>

Tere jisme naazuk par pyaas ka asar dekha
Tera chaand sa chehra khu’n me tar ba tar dekha
Maine noke naiza par haay Tera Sar dekha
Margayi na kyu’n Teri benaseeb Maa Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

<<DIVIDER>>

Kya baya’n karun Beta Mere qalb ki haalat 
Phir rahi hai aankhon me Teri chaand si surat
Kar saki na jee bhar ke haay Main Teri khidmat
Sharmsaar hai Tujh se aaj Teri Maa Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

<<DIVIDER>>

Shaahe dee’n ne dafnaaya Teri Laash ko Beta
Ahle zulm ko lekin yebhi kab gawaara tha
Qabr se nikala tha Tera khu’n bhara Laasha
Phool sa wo sar Tera aur wo sina Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

<<DIVIDER>>

Reh gaya hai nazron me Teri pyaas ka manzar
Aik boond bhi paani Mai na desaki Dilbar
Maa nisaar hojaati Tere khushk honton par
Shiddat e atash se wo Teri hichkiyaan Asghar
Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar 

<<DIVIDER>>

Kyun rahe na mehshar tak dil figaar Bano ka
Haa’n ye maatame Asghar hai qaraar Bano ka
Kya baya’n kare Ahsan haale zaar Bano ka
Umr bhar labo’n par tha haay Meri Jaa’n Asghar

<<MINI>>

Bain the ye Bano ke Mere Bezaba’n Asghar

items.title: ro ro ke ye zainab ne kaha auno mohammad
items.body:
RO RO KE YEH ZAINAB NE KAHA AUN-O-MOHD
GHAR KAR GAYE VEERAN MERA AUN-O-MOHD

<<DIVIDER>>

Pehlu me jo Tum hote to Soti thi suku’n se
Neend aayegi ab kaise bhala Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Sonchi thi jawa’n honge Meri aankhon ke taro
Tifli me huwe Mujh se juda Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Kya rooth ke Maadar se khafa hogaye pyaaron
Hojaay ye Maa Tum pa fida Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Ghar Mera hamesha ke liye kar Gaye barbaad
Aabaad huwi Karbobala Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Do chaand Mere chhup gaye badli me sitam ki
Sara jaha’n andhera hua Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Ab Tum jo nahi’n ghar mujhe achha nahi’n lagta
Yaad aati hai har ik ada Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Tanhai me ghut ghut ke sada Gham me Tumhare
Karti hu’n me raaton ko buka Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Tum sahib e aulaad jo hote to samajhte
Kis dil se di marne ki riza Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Reh reh ke khayal aata hai Tum Dono se pehle 
Kyun aayi nahi’n Mujh ko qaza Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Baalo’n se chhupaati rahi chehre ko Main Apne
Chheeni gayi jab Meri rida Aun-o-Mohd

<<DIVIDER>>

Uftaad Sohail aisi thi ik Ghamzada Maa par
Thi dil ke dhadakne ki sada Aun-o-Mohd
